segments.text: You just found twenty million dollars.
Two black duffel bags. On the side of an empty mountain road.
You pick up one stack. It's real.
Twenty million in hundreds is two hundred thousand bills.
That's about two hundred kilos of cash.
You drag both bags to your car anyway.
That night, the bags sit on your living room floor.
Unknown sender. Did you get both bags?
You type... yes. Your hands are shaking.
Good. Keep one. Bring the other to eighteen Mercer Road. Midnight.

ui.text: Good. Keep one. Bring the other back.

segments.text: And then it hits you. You never told anyone where you live.
So do you return one bag, and keep ten million? Or keep everything, and run?

options: TAKE ONE BAG TO THE ADDRESS
